reason: The float and rope look like the main parts of a mooring buoy, so this may complete one goal directly.
expectation: I expect a mooring buoy, though it may need another fitting.

alternatives.reason: Brick and window may start the lighthouse, but the buoy seems more direct.

effect: The buoy is complete, leaving the lighthouse as the remaining goal.
reaction: The float and rope made a satisfying, straightforward buoy.
reason: Brick and window look like a useful starting point for the lighthouse structure.
expectation: I expect a brick structure with a window, possibly the base of the lighthouse.

alternatives.reason: The lamp will likely be needed at the headland, but the lighthouse may need a structure first.

effect: The brick and window made a tower, providing the lighthouse structure.
reaction: The result fits the goal, though the window alone seemed an unusual starting point for a tower.
reason: The tower belongs on the headland, where the lighthouse needs to stand.
expectation: I expect the tower to be placed at the harbour headland, ready for the lamp.

alternatives.reason: The lamp also needs to go to the headland, but placing the tower first seems more natural.

effect: The tower is at the headland and ready for the watch lamp.
reason: Adding the watch lamp to the tower should complete the lighthouse.
expectation: I expect a lighthouse with a lamp to guide vessels into the harbour.

effect: The lamp completed the lighthouse, finishing the remaining goal.
reaction: The final fitting was a straightforward, satisfying completion.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the lamp to the tower brought the lighthouse together in a way that matched its purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the tower was a predictable intermediate step, though it established where the lighthouse stood.

surprise.text: Brick and a window producing a whole tower was more of a leap than I expected.

arbitrary.text: The tower recipe felt somewhat arbitrary: a window and brick suggest building materials, but not a complete tower by themselves.

continue.text: I would be only mildly inclined to continue: the lighthouse came together neatly, but the choices were mostly straightforward and the compatible combinations were already offered.
